sloka: एवमुक्तो महाबाहुर्माणिभद्रः सुदुर्जयः ।वृतो यक्षसहस्रैस्तु चतुर्भिः समयोधयत् ।। ७.१५.३ ॥
transliteration: evamukto mahābāhurmāṇibhadraḥ sudurjayaḥ ।vṛto yakṣasahasraistu caturbhiḥ samayodhayat ।। 7.15.3 ॥

translations.english: Thus addressed, the mighty-armed Manibhadra, who was very difficult to conquer, surrounded by four thousand Yakshas, then engaged in battle.
